legal_gauge.analytic_vector: equal yaw increment on all ten segment navigation frames
forbidden_rank_sources: fixed pelvis orientation treated as data

blocks.name: sensor_to_segment_longitudinal_axis
blocks.physical_role: per-donning mounting tilt and azimuth-axis binding

blocks.name: effective_relative_heading
blocks.parameterization: one yaw coordinate per non-pelvis segment
blocks.physical_role: nine independent VQF yaw-gauge differences relative to pelvis

blocks.name: limb_functional_axes
blocks.physical_role: shoulder, elbow, hip, and knee action axes fixed in each joint parent board frame and transformed at every time row

blocks.name: trunk_functional_frame
blocks.physical_role: right-handed frame fixed in the pelvis board frame from joint non-collinear axial-turn and flexion evidence; a single motion plane may not identify it

blocks.name: joint_neutral_zero
blocks.parameterization: left/right elbow, hip, knee, plus trunk
blocks.physical_role: capture-defined reporting zero with explicit non-clinical status

blocks.name: initial_still_latent_articulated_pose
blocks.parameterization: shared root SO3 (3), torso S2 (2), bilateral shoulder S2 (4), elbow flexion (2), bilateral hip S2 (4), and knee flexion (2)
blocks.rule: one connected tree with soft pose/bilateral residuals; never ten free directions and never fixed to a textbook pose

blocks.name: t_pose_latent_articulated_pose
blocks.parameterization: shared root SO3 (3), torso S2 (2), bilateral shoulder S2 (4), elbow flexion (2), bilateral hip S2 (4), and knee flexion (2)
blocks.rule: separate connected tree from initial still; soft pose/bilateral residuals; never averaged with initial still

discrete_hypotheses.policy: enumerate product-distinct alternatives and fail closed when more than one passes within the declared likelihood margin

frontend_nuisance_inputs.vqf_gyro_bias_trajectory: measured estimate with covariance, not a static-state rank source
frontend_nuisance_inputs.sample_validity_and_gap_state: propagated into factor covariance and eligibility
frontend_nuisance_inputs.timebase: single B306 clock; no fitted inter-node time shift
